{{Quote|We're the law on Coruscant. Not the Jedi.|Detective Gwad Raatu, Coruscant Security Force|<ref name="Temp">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force (CSF)''', also known as the '''Coruscant Police''' or the '''Coruscant Constabulary''', and depending on the era, less commonly known as the '''Imperial Sector Police''', '''Galactic City Police''', and '''Republic Security''', was the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] in charge of [[Planetary Security Forces|maintaining law and order]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reigns of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Its duties included regular patrols of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], criminal investigations, [[Terrorist/Legends|counter-terrorism]] and [[Spy/Legends|counter-intelligence]] operations, [[Riot|crowd control]], [[Bodyguard/Legends|diplomatic protection]], maintaining the world's [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]], and, in some cases, the military defense of Coruscant. Early during the Republic, the CSF was commanded by the [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] and centuries later by the [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command]], later the [[Sector Command (Coruscant Security Force)|Sector Command]]. As the Empire established its rule, control of the CSF was changed from the Sector Command to a [[Commander of Coruscant Security|Commander]], that position itself later replaced by a [[Commissioner of the Coruscant Constabulary|Commissioner]]. The CSF operations were based out of a [[Coruscant Security Force Headquarters|central headquarters]] and various [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|divisional headquarters]].

Though staffed mostly by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were used as well, including different [[Police droid/Legends|kinds]] of [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]], [[Police probe/Legends|probes]], and [[Forensics droid/Legends|crime scene investigation droids]]. Major crimes were investigated by [[Detective/Legends|detectives]], although [[Police rank|high-ranking]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] could also investigate such crimes. Specialized units included the [[Special Weapons Team|SWAT unit]], the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]], the [[Organized Crime Unit]], [[Traffic Division]], and the [[Forensics Unit]]. The [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of Coruscant were patrolled by the CSF's [[Coruscant Underworld Police|Underworld Police]] division. The CSF utilized [[Variable Altitude Assault Transport/enforcement|VAAT/e ships]], [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship|assault ships]], and [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunships]] as rapid [[Troop/Legends|troop]] deployment and [[Police speeder|patrol craft]]. They also had [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|Coruscant police speeders]] and [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeders]] which were used as patrol and pursuit [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. If at [[Time/Legends|times]] officers felt they could be entering a dangerous area, they could receive an escort by a [[police cruiser backup unit]].

The CSF was one of the oldest planetary police forces in the known galaxy. After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it battled for control of Coruscant against crime syndicates such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]. However, with severely depleted resources and a high rate of burnout among its embittered officers, the CSF had to leave large sections of Coruscant under gang control. During the later years of the Galactic Republic, the CSF was assisted by the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]]&mdash;who served as a secondary police force for Coruscant&mdash;and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Together, they would investigate severe crimes though rivalry and resentment were always present. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the CSF was supported by [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] and the Republic's [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. With them, the CSF was able to [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|investigate and bring down]] several [[Separatist terrorist network|terror networks]] operating on Coruscant.

When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, the CSF assisted in hunting down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], although many CSF officers were privately resentful of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Some officers turned a blind [[Eye/Legends|eye]] when spotting Jedi, and in the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]] others spied for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Under the Empire, the Coruscant Guard took over the primary responsibility of Coruscant's security. The CSF acted in a support capacity to the Guard and was staffed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as well as regular police officers. It was also given a new name, the Imperial Sector Police, though many still referred to it as Coruscant Security, Police, or Constabulary. During that time, CSF commanders shared their police officers' resistance to the Emperor's rule. A CSF [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] even took part in and led a [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|coup]] to oust Palpatine, though it ultimately failed.

The New Republic [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] Coruscant in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], disbanded the Coruscant Guard, and reinstated the CSF as the primary law enforcement agency. With the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], most of the CSF was wiped out; however, it was re-established after the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|end]] of the conflict. The [[Second Galactic Civil War]] placed the CSF in the middle of the conflict between the Galactic Alliance and the [[Confederation]]. Some CSF officers were recruited into the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] (GAG) to counter [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] activities on Coruscant. The GAG was later disbanded following the [[Battle of Uroro Station|death]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Caedus]]. After the Civil War, the CSF continued to serve as Coruscant's police force. During the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberation]] of Coruscant by the Jedi Order from the control of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], the CSF assisted the Jedi as the Sith began committing acts of terror on Coruscant. However, the CSF's casualties during the battle ran into the thousands.

==Description==
===Duties and overview===
{{Quote|Time, time, there's no ''time'' for time. A murderer's on the loose and it's my job to find him.|Lieutenant Tan Divo|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
The [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Security Force was tasked with providing [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] and security on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Coruscant. This included regular patrols of the various districts and neighborhoods of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], criminal investigations, [[Terrorist/Legends|counter-terror]] and [[Spy/Legends|counter-espionage]] operations,<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> crowd control at major events and [[Riot|public disturbances]],<ref name="Bloodlines" /> maintaining the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]], handing out speeding tickets,<ref name="compswe" /> [[Bodyguard/Legends|diplomatic protection]],<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref><ref name="lash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> and responding to a variety of other emergencies and situations.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> The CSF also had the authority to pursue investigations outside of their normal jurisdiction on Coruscant&mdash;an ability that extended even to [[Simpla-12]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment]]''</ref>

[[File:Csfdocks.png|thumb|left|250px|CSF police droids respond to and secure a crime scene during the Clone Wars.]]
From their [[Coruscant Security Force Headquarters|central headquarters]] and various [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|divisional headquarters]] in Galactic [[City/Legends|City]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> the CSF performed these duties throughout the reign of several galactic governments.<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex" /><ref name="SW Empire: Betrayal" /><ref name="Bloodlines" /><ref name="YJK:TLO" /> [[Police officer/Legends|Police officers]] would train at one of several [[Coruscant Police training academies|police academies]] before beginning their duties.<ref name="GaW" /> The majority of crime on the planet occurred in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower city levels]]. Most [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] and influential citizens refused to do much about the situation, preferring to live in the upper levels and [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]] away from the unpleasantness of the lower levels and slums. Areas such as the [[Factory District]] and the [[Crimson Corridor]] were especially heavy with crime.<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> The environment of the underworld was very cutthroat and police officers on patrol traveled frequently in groups.<ref name="TCWCatchJedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> The cops who patrolled the underworld were also notoriously harder and burlier than officers assigned to the upper levels.<ref name="CSFunderpolice">{{SWE|groups|coruscant-underworld-police|Coruscant underworld police}}</ref> [[Coruscant Security Force database|A database]] was maintained by the CSF that tracked a variety of data including a list of criminals and known areas of heavy crime.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

The CSF could be reached by their emergency call number of [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|9–1–1]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> The [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club|CSF Staff and Social Club]] was a bar favored by CSF officers. It was a location to which CSF officers often invited members of other organizations as a favor or sign of respect. Officers also frequently visited the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]], a restaurant with low rates that was known for its greasy food.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

===Organization and units===
{{Quote|I'm incident commander. I say how and when anyone goes in.|Lieutenant Dovel, to Omega Squad|<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref>}}
[[File:TanDivo-SWE.png|thumb|right|170px|CSF Lieutenant Tan Divo during the Clone Wars]]
Ultimate authority over the Coruscant Security Force rested with the current reigning government. The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Betrayal 1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref> and the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Edge of Victory II: Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Though they rarely interfered in day to day activities, they could, under certain circumstances, give orders to the CSF including assigning command positions to individuals and giving or removing responsibilities.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> The CSF provided protection services to the Chief of State, including bodyguards and intelligence information.<ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="lash" /><ref name="lotf6">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref> Day to day control of the Coruscant Security Force changed several times throughout its history. During the [[Old Republic era]], a senior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was appointed to lead the CSF with the title of [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] though he would also hold a separate [[police rank]].<ref name="SWTORCiGC" /> Centuries later, the [[Commander/Legends|commanding]] officers who were placed in charge of daily operations were collectively referred to as [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> later changed to [[Sector Command (Coruscant Security Force)|Sector Command]] under the Galactic Empire.<ref name="SWCN2" /> A few years later, a [[Commander of Coruscant Security|commander]] was placed in charge of the CSF<ref name="Betrayal 1" /> which at the time was staffed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and regular police officers.<ref name="X-wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> The post of commander was at some point removed and replaced by the position of [[Commissioner of the Coruscant Constabulary|commissioner]].<ref name="xwingkrytos" />

Lower ranks included those of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]],<ref name="SWTORcorus">{{TORcite|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Chief of Detectives]], [[Detective/Legends|Detective]],<ref name="Temp" />[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]], and Officer.<ref name="SWTORcorus" /> Although the rank of detective existed, officers of other ranks could also perform investigative-type duties. They were then referred to as [[Inspector/Legends|inspector]], along with the title of the rank that they held.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> It was common for high ranking officers to investigate high profile cases, such as those involving [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name="Senate Murders" /><ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter]]''</ref> The CSF also had other titles for various duties&mdash;[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] was used to describe those working undercover or on special assignments,<ref name="SWTORKidnapped">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped|Coruscant}}</ref> and the title of [[Incident commander]] was used by the officer in charge of a major police operation.<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets" /> The slang terms "Cop" and "[[Boys in Blue]]" were also used to refer to CSF officers.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

The patrol of the lower levels of Coruscant was left mostly to a separate CSF division, the [[Coruscant Underworld Police|Underworld Police]].<ref name="CSFunderpolice" /> The CSF also had units that specialized in responding to and dealing with specific crimes and situations. The units included [[Special Weapons Team|SWAT]] teams, an [[ordnance disposal]] unit of [[bomb disposal expert]]s,<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets" /> a [[Forensics Unit]] that was staffed by [[Scenes of Crimes Officer]]s and [[Forensics droid/Legends|crime scene investigation droids]], the [[Organized Crime Unit]], the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> and the [[Tactical and Operational]] force.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Major investigations were handled by the [[Detective division]].<ref name="lash" /> During the Old Republic era, CSF's [[Coruscant Control]] would monitor incoming and outgoing space traffic and the [[Customs Enforcement Division]] was charged with customs and immigration operations and checkpoint enforcement.<ref name="SWTORcorus" /> The CSF's [[Traffic Division]] was charged with maintaining order in the massive skylanes of Galactic City.<ref name="compswe" /><ref name="Bloodlines" /> A [[Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel|Special Investigation Panel]] oversaw all investigations of use of deadly force by law enforcement and Jedi.<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721">{{TORcite|type=message|Case File #1142-235-3721|Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel}}</ref>

===Uniforms and equipment===
{{Quote|Wearing armor may be the latest style on the Rimworlds, but here in civilization we usually take off our spacesuits, planetside. Heavy armor usually means trouble.|Coruscant Security Force files|<ref name="AHSNV">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Coruscant Security Force uniform}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] which began in [[3681 BBY]], the [[Coruscant Security Force uniform]] consisted of an off-white or tan-[[Color/Legends|colored]] uniform [[shirt]], tan pants, dark knee-high [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], a gray [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]], and a gray [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] or [[headset comlink]].<ref name="TOP" /> Shortly thereafter, the CSF uniform changed to blue-gray shirt and pants with a yellow strip that ran up the side of the pants and on the arms of the shirt, brown utility belts, and black boots. They could also done blue-gray blast vests over their chest and lower torso.<ref name="SWTORcorus" /> In the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, the general CSF uniform was a dark blue shirt and pants, dark boots, a utility belt, and dark blue body armor with a yellow blast vest as optional.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> This uniform would be used as the CSF standard in the decades to come.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

[[File:CSF_underworld_cop.jpg|thumb|left|290px|An armored CSF officer in the lower levels]]
Apart from the general, day-to-day uniform, special uniforms were used as well. If so inclined, officers could make use of black or dark blue full body armor for patrol or during demonstrations and major operations.<ref name="Bloodlines" /><ref name="Republic 73">[[Republic 73|''Republic'' 73]]</ref> Higher ranking officers could also choose to wear a strap over their right shoulder that attached to their utility belt, as well as markings on their sleeves denoting their rank.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

Officers assigned to the Underworld Police would wear heavy leather and metal armor in dark gray with yellow shoulder pads to protect them from the harsh and cut-throat environment of the Coruscant Underworld. The armor covered their faces, revealing only mechanical eye coverings. Their uniforms and armor gave them a presence of anonymity and authority. It also had the effect of gaining them a mystic reputation as few knew if they were humanoid, droids, or something else.<ref name="CSFunderpolice" />

Police officers and droids had access to a variety of regular [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]] and heavier [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]] including [[Coruscant Security Force issue blaster|issue blasters]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> [[Coruscant Security Droid Blaster|heavy blaster pistols]]<ref name="CSFunderpolice" /> and other [[SS-410 Police Special blaster pistol/Legends|pistol variations]].<ref name="lightsaberlost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> During riots and urban unrest, officers utilized the [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[R-88 Suppressor riot rifle/Legends|R-88 Suppressor riot rifle]] to pacify large crowds.<ref name="CorCWorld">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

===Droids and speeders===
{{Quote|Drop your weapons and come with us quietly!|A police droid|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
To assist in policing Coruscant's vast city, the CSF relied heavily on [[Police droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="SWEpolicedroid">{{SWE|technology|policedroid|police droid}}</ref> They were also utilized for tasks such as [[Forensics droid/Legends|crime scene investigations]],<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /><ref name="Temp" /> and as personal [[LEP-171B/Legends|assistants]].<ref name="Senate Murders" /> [[Police probe/Legends|Police probes]] were used to assist in detecting crimes and identifying suspects.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> During the Old Republic, [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] assisted in armed fights and street battles between the CSF and various gangs. At spaceports such as the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], [[Customs droid/Legends|customs droids]] assisted in handling immigration and customs processes.<ref name="SWTORcorus" />

Specialized [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|Guardian police droids]] were specifically used for assisting in patrol duties.<ref name="SWEpolicedroid" /> This included setting up a perimeter, collecting evidence, conducting preliminary interrogations, and holding and arresting suspects. Crimes that required in-depth investigations were handed over to detectives or other higher ranking organic officers.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> The droids could also use lethal force if certain perimeters were met. The rigid programming of the droids resulted in them being beyond weariness or corruption though it also would mean slick criminal could outsmart. In this, the droids, while heavily deployed, never fully replaced sentient officers.<ref name="SWEpolicedroid" /> By the end of the Clone Wars, the aging police droids were gradually phased out,<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary">{{SW|url=video/senate-murders-episode-featurette|text="Senate Murders" Episode Featurette}}</ref> though they continued to be used in the lower levels,<ref name="SofaBS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref> and were replaced by new models such as [[Policebot]]s during the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Temp" />

[[File:CSFvehicles.jpg|thumb|right|300px|CSF police speeders]]
The CSF used a variety of [[Police speeder|police vehicles]] to perform their duties. For large deployments, SWAT raids, or riot response, the CSF used the [[Variable Altitude Assault Transport/enforcement]], also known as the VAAT/e. Toward the end of the Clone Wars, the [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship]] took over those duties as the CSF's preferred [[Assault ship/Legends|assault]] and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Order66book">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> In the waning years of the Republic, the [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunship]] was developed and put into use for search operations, troop transport, and general patrol. Its use continued into the years of the Empire.<ref name="Republicpolicegunship">{{SWE|technology|republic-police-gunship|Republic police gunship}}</ref> An [[Coruscant Security Force incident support vessel|incident support vessel]] was also used for transport, crowd control, and various other support operations at major police operations and incidents.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

Depending on the area, the CSF mostly used [[Coruscant police speeders]] for patrols,<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> along with specialized [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeders]].<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> A [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] was sometimes accompanied by a [[police cruiser backup unit]] if the officers felt they needed extra assistance or were entering a potentially dangerous area.<ref name="maul">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> For escort duties, the CSF also made use of [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]].<ref name="SWUnion">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref> During the time of the Great Galactic War, the CSF was responsible for [[Orbital Security Station Six|monitoring the space traffic]] in and around Coruscant, and it used [[Orbital security station/Legends|orbital security stations]] for that purpose.<ref name="TOP">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> During the reign of the New Republic, the CSF utilized the [[Coruscant Security Force interceptor]] as a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and high altitude pursuit and defense [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]].<ref name="Edge of Victory II: Rebirth" />

===Relationship with other law enforcement===
====Jedi Order====
{{Quote|You've already started collecting evidence, and the Jedi can bring some unique resources to bear.|Luke Skywalker, to Detectives Chal Tozr and Gwad Raatu|<ref name="Temp" />}}
{{Main|Jedi Order/Legends}}
During the time of the Galactic Republic, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] served as a quasi-police force. Their positions as keepers of the peace and as protectors of the Republic gave them authority to supersede the needs of the local police to that of their own.<ref name="Darthplagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Specifically, the Jedi could claim jurisdiction over a matter if a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was involved, or at the request of the Republic.<ref name="maul" /> If involved in an incident, Jedi would inform the CSF of that but would not always give full explanations of their involvement.<ref name="Darthplagueis" /> Up until the end of the Republic, the CSF had a standing order to assist Jedi in any duties they may require.<ref name="Order66book" /> CSF officers often felt resentful when the Jedi did involve themselves, even if the CSF needed their help.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter" />

[[File:Jedi_Coruscant_Peacekeeper.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Jedi Sniper keeping watch on Coruscant]]
However, certain Jedi, specifically the [[Jedi Peacekeeper]]s willingly assisted the CSF in crime fighting on Coruscant instead of simply taking over. They would provide resources and support outside the abilities of the CSF, such as using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to study crime scenes and when conducting interrogations. The [[Temple district/Legends|Temple district]] was nominally under the protection of these Jedi and the [[Temple Security Force]]. The Jedi, however, relied on the CSF for various purposes as well. All information the Jedi had on criminal activity in the Republic would be accessed from the CSF database in the Jedi Temple [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|Analysis Rooms]]. As such, the Jedi relied on the CSF for information on crimes, criminals, and case files not only Coruscant, but throughout the galaxy.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> When warrants were issued by the Jedi on subjects, they relied on the CSF to assist in locating and arresting the wanted persons.<ref name="TCWCatchJedi" />

A former Jedi by the name of [[Lexia Ginorra]] was well known to the CSF. In the waning years of the Republic, she had renounced her ties to the Jedi Order and continued life in the underlevels of Coruscant as a vigilante. However, since she put an end to a significant level of gang violence there, the CSF did little to stop her. Instead, in many of the tales that CSF officers told amongst themselves and to others, she became the protagonist and gained the famous yet inaccurate title of "the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]."<ref name="CSWEginorralexia">{{CSWECite|I|342|Ginorra, Lexia}}</ref>

The end of the Clone Wars drastically changed the relationship between the CSF and the Jedi. The CSF disliked Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for his politics, his handling of the war, and his restriction of the resources available to the CSF. However, most CSF officers saw the Jedi as traitors for attempting to overthrow the institution of the Supreme Chancellor, and thus had no qualms assisting in the hunt for Jedi during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Nevertheless, some turned a blind [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to any Jedi they discovered.<ref name="Order66book" /> In the time of the Galactic Alliance, some CSF officers continued to resent the need of Jedi assistance, as they had in the days of the Republic.<ref name="Temp" />

====Senate Guard====
{{Quote|And you have primacy? I thought the city came under CSF jurisdiction.''"<br />"''Not as long as I have a Senator and his aide in danger.|RC-1309 "Niner" and then Senate Guard Commander Obrim|<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets" />}}
{{Main|Senate Guard/Legends}}
[[File:Senate_Guards.png|thumb|right|200px|Senate Guards]]
During the Old Republic, the CSF was charged with [[Senate Guard (Coruscant Security Force)|ensuring]] the security of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], a task they shared with the military in the form of the [[Senate Security Officer]]s, or SSOs.<ref name="SWTORsenatetowercodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Senate Tower}}</ref> As time went on the CSF was removed from this task and the duties of the SSOs developed into the long standing tradition of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]]. Though originally used strictly as a bodyguard detail, the role of the Senate Guard gradually expanded from protecting senators and other government officials to becoming a secondary police force for Coruscant. Traditionally, there was continual friction between the Senate Guard and the CSF. This began with the Senate Guard's expansion into police services which lured away the CSF's best cops as well as trainees from the CSF's police academies. Later, in demand for greater abilities to protect the senators and government officials, the Senate Guard placed the entire surrounding [[Senate District/Legends|Legislative District]] under its authority leading to open hostility between them and the CSF.<ref name="GaW" />

Never the less, the CSF still depended on the support of the Senate Guard. As the Senate District is under the control of the Guard, they were adapt at not only the protection of the senators, but also in intelligence gathering, patrol duties, and investigative techniques. It was well known that the Guard had access to the best forensic equipment available on the capital planet. [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] would frequently be called on to function as a special tactical force in extreme situations and it was not uncommon to see a Jedi as well working with the Guard detachment. The Guard also assisted the CSF with uprisings that occurred in the lower levels.<ref name="GaW" />

By the time of the Clone Wars, the Guard had become a legacy systems with whole families working as Guards for generations. Corruption became common and the effectiveness of the Guard had decreased.<ref name="GaW" /> The ability of the Guard to conduct independent and honest investigations had been put into such a question that when a homicide occurred in the Senate, the CSF was called to conduct the investigate with the Guard serving in a support capacity.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> Later, with the formation of Palpatine's [[Red Guard]], the authority of the Senate Guard was further diminished. With the formation of the Empire, the Guard was disbanded and its members joined other security forces.<ref name="GaW" />

====Coruscant Guard====
{{Quote|No, the Imperial Guard can do without me. I'd never fit in the suit now. Besides, the Emperor wants fit and dedicated young stormtroopers to do the job, and I'm an old street cop at heart.|Captain Jaller Obrim, discussing law enforcement on Coruscant|<ref name="IC501" />}}
{{Main|Coruscant Guard/Legends}}
When the Clone Wars erupted, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] came into existence to serve the Republic's defense needs. With this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army came a specialized division composed of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]]. These units were trained on Coruscant and when the war began, they were formed as the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. The troopers were stationed at important government buildings and other vital infrastructure areas to protect them from sabotage. As the war went on, the Guard's presence and authority increased and they began to take on a larger role of providing police services.<ref name="ThireCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|237|Thire, Clone Commander}}</ref> [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|Riot clone troopers]], specially trained in crowd control, were garrisoned across Coruscant in case of trouble and also assisted the CSF with fugitive chases.<ref name="CharEncyc">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[File:Shocktrooperpatrol.png|thumb|left|260px|Coruscant Guards on patrol]]
The Coruscant Guards, like most clone forces on Coruscant, maintained a good relationship with the CSF. Though the clones had superior training to the CSF cops, they worked better together than the CSF had with the Senate Guard. As the war drew to a close, it was not uncommon to see troopers on patrol with CSF officers.<ref name="Order66book" /> When the Empire was declared, the Coruscant Guards occupied the Senate Building<ref name="ThireCSWE" /> and CSF officers assisted with securing the capital.<ref name="Order66book" />

Later, the Guard became the primary law enforcement agency for Coruscant. Renamed the Imperial Guard, though still referred to as the Coruscant Guard, they were placed in primary control of investigations and policing<ref name="GaW" /> with the CSF in a support capacity. This did not go well with the CSF and it caused constant friction between the CSF and the Imperial government.<ref name="Betrayal 1" /> In response to their downgraded status, many CSF officers became spies against the Empire.<ref name="dbchyler" />

====Galactic Alliance Guard====
{{Quote|Are we doing riot control now?"''<br />''"That's CSF's problem. What we're looking for are faces we might know from the last job.|Ben Skywalker and a GAG officer formerly of CSF's Anti-Terrorism Unit|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
{{Main|Galactic Alliance Guard}}
The Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG) was designed to fill a void between the military and Coruscant's police in combating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]]. Members of the GAG were recruited from the CSF, the military, and the intelligence services. For the former cops, it became immediately apparent there was a difference in philosophy in how the GAG should operate, especially during interrogations and raids. Though the CSF was responsible for such issues as riot control and tracking criminals or other suspicious persons, information would be handed over to the GAG for assessment.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

During GAG raids, the CSF would assist by providing officers and equipment to secure the area as well as clearing out innocent civilians before an attack. The GAG also depended on CSF for intelligence gathering on suspected terrorists and any other information gathered from other agencies. Initially, the CSF officers, mostly originating from the Anti-Terrorist Unit, were enthusiastic about tackling the issue of terrorism on Coruscant with an expanded budget and an expanded ability to take action.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> But as time passed and the methods of the GAG became more and more brutal, the CSF cops and other top-of-the-line operatives left the GAG.<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> Those cops that remained passed on information to the Jedi to help bring the GAG down.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==History==
===The Old Republic===
====Beginnings and Sith invasion====
{{Quote|Unidentified vessel, this is Coruscant Security. We weren't expecting&hellip; Do you have a ''clearance'' code?|CSF agent Femi's communication to the Sith fleet|<ref name="TOP" />}}
The Coruscant Security Force was formed by the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] government and was one of the oldest planetary police forces in the Republic. Though tasked with the responsibility of keeping the peace on a planet with a massive population, the CSF maintained a reputation of effectiveness, diversity in its officers, and in general, positive relations with the population of Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex" /> [[Old Sith Wars|Continuous warfare]] between the Republic and several enemies, including the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during [[Jedi Civil War]], had drained the Republic's resources. While Coruscant was placed under tight security in fear of external threats, the government lacked the necessary manpower to properly police the planet itself. As such, various corporations provided private [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] for patrol duties to supplement the government's police and military troops. The move, while deemed necessary, raised concerns and questions from many Republic citizens.<ref name="CGKotOR">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:Csfandjedi.jpg|thumb|right|210px|CSF officers conferring with Jedi Master Din during the Sith attack]]
Several centuries later in [[3653 BBY]], the CSF were the first to come in contact with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] when the Sith began the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. At the time of the attack, CSF's [[Orbit/Legends|Orbital]] Security Station Six was in charge of monitoring starship traffic around Coruscant. An all-clear report was given to [[Coruscant Control]] by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Femi]], a CSF agent assigned to Orbital Station Six. Following the report, a Sith [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] entered Coruscant [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and the CSF security station requested clearance codes from the fleet, unsure of who they were. The Sith fleet was commanded by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], who ordered the fleet to destroy the station, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the CSF agents on board in the process. The Sith then began their invasion of the planet.<ref name="TOP" />

A hijacked Republic transport was used to attack the Jedi Temple and disable Coruscant's security grid, allowing the Sith to bombard the planet. Within minutes, communications, military, and security installations were destroyed.<ref name="TJoMGDreal">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> A [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] landed at the Senate Building, where the Sith were met with resistance from CSF officers, [[Republic Special Forces Division]] Lieutenant [[Harron Tavus]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], but they were unable to prevent the Sith from storming the Senate Building and killing Supreme Chancellor [[Berooken]].<ref name="TOP" /> A small group of security forces rallied a defense but were quickly overwhelmed. The Sith occupied key sections of Coruscant; however, the majority of the lower levels remained firmly under Republic and CSF control though the security forces were shocked and disorganized.<ref name="TJoMGDreal" />

The Sith armies did not have the numbers to press the attack or to maintain an extended occupation. It was noted later on by the Jedi that had security forces been able to launch a counterattack, while causing a significant toll on the civilian population, it would have been successful. Thus the Sith quickly withdrew from Coruscant, but not before they had used their occupation of the planet to force the Senate into the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], starting the military and economic [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the Sith Empire.<ref name="TJoMGDreal" /> After signing the treaty, the Galactic Senate was forced to make difficult decisions on prioritizing the Republic's resources. Only those parts of Coruscant that were vital for the running of the government and for trade were rebuilt and large parts of Galactic City remained in ruins.<ref name="Holonet-Coruscant">{{Holonet|planets|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> The lack of resources fell heavily on the CSF which was pulled back from various sectors to protect the Senate Building and other vital government and infrastructure areas.<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex" />

====Picking up the pieces====
{{Quote|I used to be proud to say, 'Lieutenant Doorn, Coruscant Security Forces.' These days, it's just a job. Doesn't even pay the bills.|Lieutenant Doorn|<ref name="SWTORsecpassages">{{TORcite|type=general|Secret Passages|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
In the aftermath of the Sacking of Coruscant, the CSF had to deal with not only the limited resources, but also the loss of life from the invasion and the burnout from the years following it, all of which took their toll. In the years after the invasion as the Republic struggled to rebuild, the CSF was constantly engaged in riot control only to see those areas fall to major criminal syndicates. The inability to prevent the takeover by gangs embittered many of the CSF's young recruits. Veteran cops were equally frustrated, as they had been trained to investigate crimes and track individuals, not fight gangs for territory block by block.<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex" />

[[File:CSFswtor.svg|thumb|left|200px|CSF symbol during the Cold War]]
The [[Black Sun territory|territory]] controlled by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate was especially dangerous, and the CSF rarely ventured into it. Traffic in the area was erratic and dangerous with illegal craft flying everywhere.<ref name="TORweb-Coruscant screenshot 4">{{TORweb|url=media/screens/coruscant-4|text=Coruscant screenshot 4|nolive=1}}</ref> When the CSF did enter the Black Sun area, they regularly ended up in desperate fights over territory, even over just the landing platforms.<ref name="TORweb-Coruscant screenshot 3">{{TORweb|url=media/screens/coruscant-3|text=Coruscant screenshot 3|nolive=1}}</ref> Officers [[Berric]], [[Kennerlo Erlo]], [[Tomin-brel]], and [[Shassa]] were stationed in the area to provide armor and weapons.<ref name="SWTORcorus" /> In response to the takeover by Black Sun, several ex-soldiers formed a [[Militia/Legends|militia]], the [[Justicars' Brigade]].<ref name="SWTORJustcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Justicars' Brigade}}</ref> They claimed to be responsible for peace and order, but their methods were brutal, and they were subsequently seen as bloodthirsty and a law unto themselves.<ref name="TORFA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> Coruscant's government declared them illegal, but the Justicars cut themselves off from the outside world and enforced a heavy-handed marshal law in [[Justicar territory|their territory]].<ref name="SWTORJustcodex" /> Initially the CSF had enthusiastically supported the Justicars, intending to work together to restore order. However, with their brutal methods revealed, the CSF began investigating the Justicars and sent in undercover agents to disrupt their activities.<ref name="SWTORwhitenoise">{{TORcite|type=general|White Noise|Coruscant}}</ref>

Debates over how to deal with the problems of retaking areas from gangs were common. Many advocated that the CSF be trained as a military unit and given military-grade equipment, arguing that without it, the CSF would be overwhelmed. Few in the CSF itself were for increased militarization, however&mdash;their goal was to keep the peace, not fight a war on the streets of Coruscant more than they already were.<ref name="SWTORCSFcodex" /> In an attempt to regain control over the areas dominated by the Black Sun, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] assisted the CSF in monitoring areas known for criminal activity with the hopes that tracking Black Sun's [[Slavery/Legends|slavery ring]] would also yield information about the Sith Empire.<ref name="TORTLS1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>

====Struggles and investigations====
{{Quote|Well, with so much money going into the military, we don't get much in terms of funds or manpower.|CSF Agent Jaffkee|<ref name="SWTORwhitenoise" />}}
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR dates|1}}</ref> when plans of long-forgotten [[Coruscant secret underground tunnels|secret tunnels]] running under Coruscant were stolen by the Justicars, CSF Lieutenant [[Doorn]] was tasked with recovering them. An individual offered their assistance to Doorn. Happily accepting, Doorn sent the individual to a female agent of the Strategic Information Service, [[Fieler Dan]]. Though Dan informed the individual of the plan's location, she requested to be able to copy the plans to give to her daughter. They would then be used to assist in bringing food and supplies to Coruscant's needy. After they infiltrated the [[Justicars' Tower|Justicars' stronghold]] and retrieved the plans, the individual let Dan make a copy of the plans. The individual then returned them to Doorn, who accepted them gratefully.<ref name="SWTORsecpassages" /> Though the CSF did not try to retake the Justicar territory by force, they conducted undercover operations to disrupt Justicar activities. CSF Agent [[Jaffkee]] was sent to infiltrate the Justicars' Territory and set up listening posts. This allowed the CSF to monitor Justicar conversations.<ref name="SWTORwhitenoise" />

[[File:Csfsenate.png|thumb|right|270px|A CSF officer guarding the Senate Building]]
The individual also assisted CSF Officer [[Anstiss]]. Anstiss felt she had an enemy at CSF Headquarters since she had been assigned the task of arresting a brutal [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal named [[Gambo]] by herself. However, Gambo had resisted and beaten her up. Anstiss asked the individual for help in arresting the suspect. The individual entered the [[Dealer's Den]] cantina where Gambo was staying and convinced him to surrender to Anstiss. Gambo did so and was escorted back to CSF Headquarters.<ref name="SWTORCantina">{{TORcite|type=general|Cantina Contusions|Coruscant}}</ref>

When several of the Jedi Order's prized [[noetikon]]s went missing, the order sent a Jedi [[The Barsen'thor|Consular]] to retrieve the stolen noetikons. During the search, the Jedi discovered that a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] criminal who was arrested by CSF Officer [[Alec Efran]] was connected to the thefts, specifically that of the [[Noetikon of Science]]. The Jedi met Efran, who was holding the Gand, at the Old Galactic Market CSF barricades. There, the Jedi questioned the Gand, leading to the retrieval of the missing Noetikon of Science.<ref name="SWTORss">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Secret Signals|Coruscant}}</ref>

Around that time, CSF Lieutenant [[Semphi Talen]] was assigned to investigate a break-in at the [[First Bank of Coruscant]]. Two individuals were caught attempting to crack open a safety deposit box belonging to the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House Ulgo|House]] of [[Ulgo]]. The robbers claimed to be Ulgo cousins, trying to reclaim "valuable family heirlooms." The deposit box contained items smuggled from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Lieutenant Talen assumed the Ulgos were planning to sell them on the black market to start raising more supporters for their cause. As Alderaan had seceded from the Republic, the case was a legal gray area. The Senate authorized for the safety deposit box to be placed in Jedi custody and the matter turned over the Order, much to the relief of Lieutenant Talen.<ref name="SWTORTalen">{{TORcite|type=message|House Ulgo's accounts|Lieutenant Semphi Talen (Coruscant Security)}}</ref>

The CSF also investigated an airspeeder crash in Coruscant's upper levels that killed [[Zorin Krasul]], Senator of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. The CSF refused to comment on the cause of the crash.<ref name="SWTORKrasul">{{TORcite|type=message|FW Senator Krasul|General Garza}}</ref> Senator Krasul, incidentally, had been at a senate hearing where he had ordered another senator, [[Grom Zian]], arrested by CSF Senate Guards for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="SWTORTSI">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|The Senate Inquiry|Coruscant}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

====Fighting the Merchants' Guild====
{{Quote|The Migrant Merchants' Guild is dug in hard. Gonna be a while before we push them out.|Captain Winborn, Coruscant Security Chief|<ref name="SWTORCiGC" />}}
Riots that had occurred in the [[Old Galactic Market]] had left the area vulnerable as the CSF pulled back their resources. Taking advantage of the situation, the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] took over the area. While on paper it officially advocated for the refugees, the Guild was a well organized gang involved in money laundering, extortion, bribery, and goods smuggling resulting in clashes with the CSF who tried to keep the peace.<ref name="SWTORMMGcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Migrant Merchants' Guild}}</ref>
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The Guild's presence prevented the CSF from assisting citizens with various complaints that were not significant enough to start a street battle over. One such case invloved [[Nik Deleru]] and his mate [[Ria Deleru|Ria]]. Deleru reported to Officer [[Mal]] that Ria had been taken by the Guild to become a dancer. However Mal was unable to pursue the investigation as Ria was in deep in the Guild's territory. An individual was able to locate Ria and discover that she had voluntarily left Deleru as he had mistreated her.<ref name="SWTORBetWors">{{TORcite|type=general|For Better or Worse|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:CSFbomb.png|thumb|left|280px|CSF officers under fire in the Old Galactic Market]]
Around 3643 BBY,<ref name="SWTORdate" /> the Migrant Merchants' Guild attempted to blackmail Coruscant's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vanara Kayl]] over her use of their funds to pay for support in the election. In response to the threat, the Senator sent the CSF to move out the Guild from the Old Galactic Market as well as to prevent them from carrying out an attack on the skylanes around the Senate Building.<ref name="SWTORCiGC" /> The CSF Chief of Security, Captain [[Winborn]], personally led the [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|attack]] on the Guild with several officers and security droids. The CSF were assisted by an individual who not only was able to neutralize several dozen of the Guild thugs, but also prevent them from accessing the secure skylane infrastructure. After the fight, the individual found a recording of Senator Kayl arguing with a leader of the Merchant Guild, exposing her illegal actions during the election. Feeling the issue was above his head and a political minefield, Winborn asked the individual to confront the Senator with the information.<ref name="SWTORCiGC" />

The CSF was brought in to investigate the theft of valuable items from Senator [[Doli-bur Barc]]. The investigating officer, Captain [[Denal-zon]], was able to determine that the Migrant Merchant Guild had been behind the theft. Denal-zon also discovered that the valuable items were in fact computer chips meant to be used in [[Shock collar/Legends|slave collars]]. Since the existence of the collars violated [[Republic Law 44-12]] and were also not to be found, the investigation subsequently stalled. Later, an individual was commissioned by one of Senator Barc's assistants to investigate the theft. After speaking with Denal-zon the individual was able to recover the computer chips from the Migrant Merchant guild. The individual than turned the chips over to Denal-zon who destroyed them since they were against Republic law.<ref name="SWTORsenstolgoods">{{TORcite|type=general|The Senator's Stolen Goods|Coruscant}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

====Battling Black Sun====
{{Quote|If we had more Jedi like you working the streets, Black Sun would be a thing of the past.|Officer Stansun to a Jedi Knight|<ref name="SWTORFacemerchant">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Face Merchants|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In the years after the Sacking of Coruscant, Black Sun had quickly established itself as a major force especially in Coruscant's lower levels. Though the CSF was underfunded and under equipped to properly push Black Sun back, attempts were still made to shut the crime syndicate down, one step at a time. One such instance involved CSF Officer [[Stansun]]. He had discovered a medical clinic that was a front for Black Sun to conduct surgeries altering the appearances of wanted criminals. Stansun was assisted by an individual who infiltrated the clinic. The individual then destroyed the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] present at the clinic and removed all the records of the clinics patients. The records gave Officer Stansun the names of all those who had had face altering surgery and their present appearance.<ref name="SWTORFacemerchant" />

[[File:Csfblacksunfight.png|thumb|right|290px|CSF officers battle Black Sun members]]
As reconstruction efforts continued, Coruscant was flooded with refugees whose homes were destroyed during the war. As the refugees scavenged for food, Black Sun booby trapped supply boxes to explode when a person would try to open it. Though most of the CSF had pulled out from those areas, Captain [[Theraguin]] continued to work in the area attempting to help the refugees by disarming the bombs. However, he was outnumbered and unable to keep up with Black Sun's terrorism campaign. A little later, an individual offered their assistance in disarming the bombs and Theraguin gladly accepted. The individual was able to locate and defuse the explosives as well as take out the Black Sun members responsible for the acts.<ref name="SWTORboom">{{TORcite|type=general|Boom|Coruscant}}</ref>

As Black Sun's power grew, the CSF began operations to infiltrate the organization. Agent [[Tema Folaris|Folaris]] was in charge of a network of spies, infiltrators, and snitches who reported on Black Sun activities. However, Black Sun planned to clean house and was able to obtain a list of the snitches and spies within its ranks. Folaris requested assistance from an individual to retrieve the list. The individual was able to locate the list and hand it over to Folaris. List in hand, Folaris contemplated selling it but was convinced instead to hand it over to her superiors.<ref name="SWTORPartEclip">{{TORcite|type=general|Partial Eclipse|Coruscant}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

====Securing the Planet Prison====
{{Quote|Go to these coordinates. Talk to Sergeant Nidaljo. He can help you rescue Doctor Tarnis and get those copied data files.''"<br />"''This mission is too important to fail. I'll take all the help I can get.|SIS Agent Galen briefs the Jedi Knight|<ref name="SWTORKidnapped" />}}
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
While jostling for advantage in the Cold War, the Republic government began secretly building weapons in expectation of an inevitable renewed war with the Empire. One of the weapons included the [[Planet Prison]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] to trap all occupants of a planet on its surface. However the data files for the Planet Prison along with valuable military hardware were stolen<ref name="SWTORStolensecrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> around 3643 BBY.<ref name="SWTORdate" /> Republic Strategic Information Service Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] was brought in to head the investigation along with members of the CSF. After the investigators found that a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Vistis Garn]] was behind the theft, a Jedi [[Hero of Tython|Knight]] was charged with recovering the plans. They tracked Garn to his hideout in the Migrant Merchants' Guild territory and recovered the data files.<ref name="SWTORStolensecrets" />

[[File:CSFspecialtacunit.png|thumb|left|250px|Sergeant Nidaljo's special tactical unit]]
While the Jedi recovered the files, Doctor Tarnis was kidnapped by members of Black Sun. The Jedi Knight and Padawan [[Kira Carsen]] were sent with a detachment of CSF agents to the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] [[Docking Bay 84]] to [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|rescue]] Tarnis. Though somewhat outnumbered, the Jedi and CSF agents were able to kill or arrest the Black Sun members. They discovered that the Black Sun members had been a distraction and that Tarnis had really been taken deep into Black Sun territory.<ref name="SWTORKidnapped" />

SIS Agent Galen offered the Jedi the assistance of a [[special tactical unit]] of CSF and Republic soldiers under the command of CSF Sergeant [[Nidaljo]]. The unit had been able to [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|battle]] their way into the Black Sun territory and set up a barricade. However, the fight had been costly and the unit had lost four men and at least seven were wounded with the remaining forces now surrounded by Black Sun's soldiers. Nidaljo and his men had lost hope for recovering Doctor Tarnis and surviving when the Jedi arrived to assist. Together, the tactical unit and the Jedi were able to break through Black Sun's forces. They found [[Salarr]], leader of Black Sun, talking with Doctor Tarnis via a holocam. Tarnis was in actuality a Sith Lord who had been manipulating the situation from the beginning and was in league with Black Sun. In the ensuing confrontation, Salarr was killed. Though a devastating blow had been struck on Black Sun, it was not enough to hold on to the territory and the CSF forces withdrew. The Jedi meanwhile continued on in their hunt for Lord Tarnis.<ref name="SWTORRescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

====Intercepting smugglers====
{{Quote|Just try to remain calm miss, we'll get this sorted out.|A CSF customs guard|<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around 3643 BBY,<ref name="SWTORdate" /> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] was stopped by the Customs Enforcement Division at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]]. The customs droid noticed an error in the smuggler's identification protocols and the cargo logs. The customs droid was about to request assistance from a customs enforcement agent when the smuggler uploaded false data that convinced the droid the smuggler was really named [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Numinn]]. The customs droid approved the smuggler's entry into Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORcorus" />
{{Endgame}}
[[File:Csfcop.png|thumb|right|280px|A CSF officer at the Coruscant Spaceport]]
In [[3640 BBY]], Strategic Information Service Agent [[Theron Shan]] sent the smuggler [[Teff'ith]] to Coruscant to give vital information about his mission to [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. As she entered Coruscant's airspace, Teff'ith was contacted by [[Coruscant Flight Control 473]] who directed her to land at [[Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B]]. Upon her arrival at the spaceport, Teff'ith was checked and searched by CSF guards. To them, the shoulder wound Teff'ith had sustained before leaving for Coruscant and the fact that she was not a Jedi, did not match with the fact that she had been flying a Jedi craft. Teff'ith continued to insist that she wanted to speak with Grand Master Shan but the guards simply took her into the spaceport office. However, the guards were unhurried. In frustration, Teff'ith grabbed the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] side arm of [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 1|one]] of the guards. His [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 2|partner]] ordered her to drop the weapon and release her hostage but she refused. Demanding he exit the spaceport office, the partner retreated outside and Teff'ith barricaded herself inside with the other guard. She insisted he contact Grand Master Shan which he set about attempting to do. Meanwhile his partner had called for backup and within five minutes over twenty CSF officers had responded to the scene, constructing a cordon around the office. The guard inside was able to contact Grand Master Shan who agreed to come to the spaceport. When she arrived, Teff'ith surrendered and informed her of the vital information.<ref name="Annihilation" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|defeat]] of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Lylos Tannon]] was investigating a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] scam run by Doctor [[Zeke]] and his assistant [[Bolgm]]. Though she tracked their activities for weeks, she was unable to catch them in the act and enlisted the help of SIS Agents Theron Shan and [[Jonas Balkar]]. During a sting operation in the Dealer's Den, Tannon accused Shan of cheating at [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] which brought the attention of Bolgm since Shan had cyber implants. Though Shan was at first unaware of Tannon's identity, he went along with the ruse until Doctor Zeke showed himself. Tannon then distracted Bolgm and Shan charged at him before Tannon knocked the criminal unconscious with the butt of her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Shan meanwhile chased after Doctor Zeke and was joined by Balkar. Shan tackled the doctor and Tannon was able to place him in cuffs.<ref name="OneNightDD">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150213|text="One Night in the Dealer's Den"|int=One Night in the Dealer's Den}}</ref>

===The Galactic Republic===
====Politics and murders====
{{Quote|It's done in any case.''"<br />"''And without any leads for the police or the Jedi to pursue, you're completely in the clear.|Palpatine and Sate Pestage, discussing the results Vidar Kim's assassination ordered by Palpatine|<ref name="Darthplagueis" />}}
Millennia later, in [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]], the CSF took custody of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Lorian Nod]], a failed Jedi Knight, and [[Eero Iridian]] from Jedi Knight [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. The pirates had attacked Senator [[Blix Annon]] and were captured on [[Von-Alai]] by the Jedi, and they were then transported to Coruscant for trial. Nod was incarcerated for his crimes, but he helped the CSF with problems they were having inside the prison, serving as an informer. In gratitude for his assistance, Nod was granted early release from prison.<ref name="LegJedi">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref>

[[File:Palpatineyouth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The CSF attempted to investigate several murders committed by Darth Plagueis and Palpatine.]]
In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] Senator [[Vidar Kim]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was assassinated while riding in an airspeeder with his son, Jedi Knight [[Ronhar Kim]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] approached from behind on a speeder bike and killed the senator. Jedi Kim jumped from the speeder and knocked the assassin to the ground. While Kim attempted to [[Mind trick/Legends|interrogate]] the assassin, the being produced a hypodermic needle and injected himself, dying instantly. The CSF initially investigated the murder with little success. Later the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] as well as the Jedi Order and [[Senate Investigative Committee]] attempted to unravel the mystery but with equal little success. Unknown to them, Palpatine had ordered the hit on Kim to allow him to become Naboo's senator. Three months later, the Senate held a major vote on whether to allow several planets who were under the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] control to enter the Republic and receive senatorial representation. In anticipation of the event, the CSF cordoned off a large area around the Senate Building including from [[Senate District Level 55|Level 55]] to [[Senate District Level 106|Level 106]]. They also deployed [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], security cam droids, and bomb detecting droids.<ref name="Darthplagueis" />

After the vote, the CSF were summoned by two Jedi Knights to investigate a grisly crime scene at the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|headquarters]] of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]]. Upon their arrival they discovered dozens and dozens of dead including two [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] warriors believed to be bodyguards, twelve [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and triple that number of [[Maladian]] assassins dressed in the Canted Circle Order's robes who had been killed by blaster fire and traumatic amputations. The Order's members whose robes had been borrowed, were bound and unconscious and lay in various locations. The amputated remains of the Maladians were so scattered that the CSF detectives initially surmised an explosive had detonated though no explosive evidence could be found. The Jedi who had notified the police, did not reveal why they had been at the location and why they had an interest in the case.<ref name="Darthplagueis" />

A second major crime scene at the [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] embassy also had the CSF engaged. There, Senator [[Pax Teem]] of Malaster along with several guest had been killed and the embassy completely burned. The CSF was able to determine that due to numerous amount of blood discovered at the scene of the fire, the victims had been killed first before the setting of the fire. This led the police detectives to believe that the mass killings and fire were a hit orchestrated by organized crime. Unknown to the CSF, the scene at the Chanted Circle headquarters was the result of Senator Teem hiring the Maladian assassins to kill [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], the alter ego of Darth Plagueis. The assassination had been interrupted by Palpatine and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] who together with Plagueis had killed the Maladians. Palpatine, filled with rage, had gone after Senator Teem, invading the residence and massacring the security guards and the dinner guests before setting Teem on fire along with the rest of the building. The sudden activity of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] had alerted the Jedi who sent two members of the Jedi Council to scene. However, the Jedi, as before, refused to clarify their presence and interest in the case. With the Jedi, the Order of the Canted Circe, InterGalactic Banking Clan, and the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] remaining silent, the case stalled despite attempts by the Senate Investigative Committee to continue the investigation.<ref name="Darthplagueis" />

====Scientists, Sith, and Jedi====
{{Quote|This is not the first body we've found drained of blood. Drifter, lowlifes&mdash;beings no one would miss. Over the past year, there have been a half dozen. Maybe more we haven't found. Who knows?|Yur T'aug to Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter" />}}
[[File:Obi-Wan_Kenobi_EP1.png|thumb|right|175px|A young Obi-Wan Kenobi assisted in several CSF investigations.]]
In [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Yur T'aug]] was a captain in the CSF. He was called in to investigate the murder of [[Fligh]], who had been found in the [[Lane of All Worlds]], an alleyway next to the Senate Building. Fligh was a petty thief but also an informant for Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn. T'aug discovered what he thought was an interesting detail: Fligh's body had been drained of [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. [[Didi Oddo]], a friend of Jinn, informed the Jedi of Fligh's murder. When Jinn and his Padawan, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], went to the crime scene and asked to see the body, T'aug consented. After some questioning by the Jedi, T'aug reluctantly revealed information about the case.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter" />

On Simpla-12, the body of [[Ren S'orn]] was discovered, and T'aug was sent to investigate. As S'orn's body had likewise been drained of blood, T'aug decided to drop the case. When he was confronted about this by Kenobi, the Captain openly refused to cooperate with the Jedi. He did, however, reveal that the case had been dropped at the request of Senator [[Uta S'orn]], Ren S'orn's mother. When questioned by Kenobi, the Senator said that she was afraid of what T'aug would find and that she simply wished the matter to go away. The Jedi later discovered that Ren had been murdered by [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who had conducted experiments on Ren before killing him. Fligh had faked his own death in order to escape to [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] after he had stolen Senator S'orn's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the CSF came into conflict with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] when he was pursuing a group through the [[Crimson Corridor]] that included Jedi Padawan [[Darsha Assant]] and information broker [[Lorn Pavan]], as they were in the possession of a special [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] containing information about the ongoing [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade of Naboo]]. The Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], wanting to quickly gain a means of transportation, hacked into Coruscant's [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|security dispatch]] system, sending out a call reporting a droid banking crime. Two CSF officers, accompanied by a police cruiser backup unit, responded to the call. However, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul disabled the PCBU by jumping on top of it and destroying the droid with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The officers turned their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] around, only to be killed by the Sith, who sliced through their [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with his weapon. The Sith then took one of the officer's speeders and continued his pursuit of Pavan and Assant.<ref name="maul" />

The CSF later investigated the incident but was unable to explain how someone could jump fifteen [[Foot/Legends|feet]] into the air to reach the PCBU without getting shot. Kenobi was present at the investigation while searching for the missing Assant. He discussed the matter with the two investigators, a [[Unidentified Mrlssi investigator|Mrlssi]] and a [[Unidentified Sullustan investigator|Sullustan]], promising the assistance of the Jedi Order. However, the issue was pushed aside upon his return to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], as he was sent to respond to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="maul" /> It was also at that time that the CSF investigated the death of a Hutt nightclub owner and several of his thugs, who had all been killed by Maul in an attempt to find Pavan. A fragment of the report would be found years later by former Imperial aide, [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]].<ref name="SWCN2" />

====Death sticks and Jango Fett====
{{Quote|Jerveis Gloom. Coruscant Police want him alive. My sources tell me he works the entertainment sector.|Rozatta to Jango Fett|<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Coruscant_police_officer.png|thumb|left|180px|A CSF police officer]]
During the time of the Invasion of Naboo, the CSF had several [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] open for various cases. One was for [[Regg Kuuga]], a male [[Draag]] from [[Ninzam VI]]. Kuuga made a habit of stealing medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], scrapping them for parts, and then transforming them to attack tourist ships. Another was on [[Panza Hondi]], a [[Guineo]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived in the industrial district. While working with crime lord [[Groff Haugg]], Hondi had brutally murdered an off-duty officer. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Ninopas Orocc]] was wanted for disrupting a meeting of the Galactic Senate; Orocc had managed to get into the Senate Building and smear [[Cornesian Wax|Cornesian wax]] across the base of several hover platforms, resulting in the injury of three senators. There was also a bounty open on [[Kiatha]], a male [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who had had mishandled his [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]], resulting in the creature causing extensive property damage. All of those bounties were claimed by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During his time on Coruscant, Fett collected several bounties that had been issued by various organizations and cartels for the capture or death of various CSF officers. Officer [[Loowil Galt]], who had arrested a contractor resulting in the collapse of a major deal between the contractor and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. In response, the Techno Union placed a bounty on Galt's head. Fett was able to locate and kill him. Captain [[Max Ryko]] received a bounty for attempting to blackmail a senator; Captain [[Lye Rooker]], for not paying back a loan; Officer [[Mill Timmer]], a corrupt cop who took too much than what he was allotted and was killed by Fett. And finally Fett assassinated Officer [[Raim Tibekk]] for his part in a [[Raid in the Entertainment District|raid]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]] where Tibekk killed a [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] operative.<ref name="Bounty Hunter" />
{{Endgame}}

Around the same time, the sale of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] on Coruscant rose dramatically as the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebolto]] expanded [[Sebolto's drug cartel|his cartel]] into the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] with the help of several Grans&mdash;including [[Kram Ayuk]], [[Byhdee Kees]], [[Seed Machees]], and [[Leek Onees]]&mdash;who smuggled the death sticks into Coruscant. The CSF became aware of Sebolto's smuggling activities and placed bounties on all four of the Gran's heads. The bounties were later collected by Fett. While the CSF was investigating the death stick distribution network, they were called to respond to a situation at the apartment of Senator [[Connus Trell]]. When they arrived in a VAAT/e police craft, they found Fett interrogating Trell while holding him over the balcony of the Senator's apartment. Fett had learned earlier from [[Jervis Gloom]], a death stick dealer also wanted by the CSF, that Trell was involved in the death stick scheme and Fett wanted Trell's contacts. The CSF officers demanded that Fett release the Senator, but Fett did so by dropping the Senator to his death. The bounty hunter then fired on the VAAT/e, destroying it and escaping the scene.<ref name="Bounty Hunter" />

====Routine investigations====
{{Quote|With high-profile cases involving politicians, rookies can get nervous, someone obviously got over-anxious and returned the vehicle without filing documentation.|Investigating officer Wets Tranoj, explaining the speeder's second disappearance|<ref name="HNN" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Detective Constable [[Dherik Rule]] was on call in the [[Taung Heights]] district when a women by the name of [[Latika Garboren]] called to report that she had discovered a Sith emblem in her [[pastebread]]. Rule responded to the scene but in the end dismissed the call as their had been no evidence of any crime.<ref name="HNNsith">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_2.html|Area Woman Finds Sith Icon in Pastebread}}</ref>

Soon thereafter, CSF investigators responded to the scene of an airspeeder collision in the [[Bindai District]]. There they discovered the dead body of Senator [[Nemrileo irm-Drocubac]] of [[Tanjay IV]]. The senator had been traveling in his airspeeder when it collided with a delivery truck. Upon investigating the scene further, investigators came to the conclusion that there had been an internal guidance error. The police did not expect to file any charges in the incident and the senator was laid to rest.<ref name="HNNair">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_6.html|Tanjay IV Representative Dead in Crash}}</ref>

[[File:CoruscantPolice.jpg|thumb|right|250px|CSF officers in a police VAAT/e transport]]
Later that year, Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] became the victim of an attempted [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination]]. At the request of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, the Jedi Council assigned Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his padawan, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to protect the Senator. However, Skywalker felt that the job of protecting the Senator should be the job of the local security forces so that they could investigate the assassination attempt itself.<ref name="SWAotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

At that time, Officer [[Wets Tranoj]] investigated the theft of Senator [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade's]] [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]]. The speeder was discovered thirty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] after it had been stolen from a [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|Senatorial Quarters]] parkway. The police were notified of the theft by a security system after seeing a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] male leap into the vehicle and tear away from the parkway. As the CSF was looking at the found speeder, a youth came out from the [[Snapping Septoid/Legends|Snapping Septoid]] entertainment facility. Seeing the CSF police officers, the youth started running away from them and yelling. Tranoj arrested the youth, [[Reymet Autem]], and charged him with the theft after he admitted that he had been at Greyshade's quarters. This was somewhat of an embarrassment for all concerned because not only was Reymet the son of Senate Guard [[Sagoro Autem]], but Sagoro was the designated bodyguard of Greyshade, the owner of the stolen speeder.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|news/13516_5.html|Senate Speeder Thief Arrested}}</ref>

The speeder again went briefly missing from the crime scene while the CSF processed Reymet Autem. However, the speeder was found returned to its original parking spot at the [[Senatorial speeder barn]]. Tranoj explained it as an error by rookie police officer overlooking some paperwork.<ref name="HNN" /> This allowed its use by the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi&mdash;who had borrowed the speeder to chase down the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after she attempted to again assassinate Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;to go unnoticed.<ref name="SWAotC" />

===The Clone Wars===
====Clones and Jedi take action====
{{Quote|I wish the public realized what those boys do, I hate kriffing secrecy sometimes.|Captain Jaller Obrim, discussing the Clone commandos|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
In 22 BBY, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="SWAotC" /> As part of the increasing security changes, shock troopers from the Grand Army of the Republic were stationed on Coruscant and assigned to the Coruscant Guard.
